title: A Multi-Agent Human-LLM Collaborative Framework for Closed-Loop Scientific Literature Summarization
abstract: arXiv:2604.01452v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Scientific discovery is slowed by fragmented literature that requires excessive human effort to gather, analyze, and understand. AI tools, including autonomous summarization and question answering, have been developed to aid in understanding scientific literature. However, these tools lack the structured, multi-step approach necessary for extracting deep insights from scientific literature. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new possibilities for literature analysis, but remain unreliable due to hallucinations and incomplete extraction. We introduce Elhuyar, a multi-agent, human-in-the-loop system that integrates LLMs, structured AI, and human scientists to extract, analyze, and iteratively refine insights from scientific literature. The framework distributes tasks among specialized agents for filtering papers, extracting data, fitting models, and summarizing findings, with human oversight ensuring reliability. translated_title: 面向闭环式科学文献总结的多智能体人机（人类-大语言模型）协作框架
translated_abstract: 科学发现因碎片化的文献而放缓，这些文献需要耗费大量人力来收集、分析和理解。包括自动摘要和问答在内的AI工具已被开发用于辅助理解科学文献，然而这些工具缺乏从科学文献中提取深层洞见所需的结构化、多步骤方法。大语言模型（LLMs）为文献分析提供了新的可能性，但由于幻觉和不完全提取问题，其可靠性仍然不足。我们提出了Elhuyar，一个多智能体、人在回路中的系统，它整合了大语言模型、结构化AI和人类科学家，以从科学文献中提取、分析并迭代完善洞见。该框架将任务分配给专门的智能体，分别负责筛选论文、提取数据、拟合模型和总结发现，并通过人类监督确保可靠性。
tldr: 该论文提出了Elhuyar——一个融合大语言模型、结构化AI与人类科学家监督的多智能体人在回路框架，通过专门化智能体分工（筛选论文、提取数据、拟合模型、总结发现）实现闭环式的科学文献总结与洞见迭代提炼。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Elhuyar, a multi-agent human-in-the-loop framework that integrates LLMs, structured AI, and human oversight to reliably extract and iteratively refine insights from scientific literature through closed-loop summarization.
